stay.name: Kasteel Gemert

packages.name: Dine & Stay
packages.includes: A night in the Garden Suite, the six-course menu for two, a bottle of champagne or minibar refreshments on arrival, breakfast the next morning (drinks at dinner extra)

packages.name: The Garden Suite
packages.includes: A night in the Garden Suite for two, a glass of champagne, the six-course Journey Menu for two (drinks extra), breakfast, valet parking inside the castle gates

packages.name: The Donjon Tower Suite
packages.includes: A night in the Donjon Tower Suite for two, welcome bite and champagne, the six-course Journey Menu for two (drinks extra), breakfast, valet parking

stay.note: Two suites inside the 14th-century Kasteel Gemert (a Donjon tower suite and a Garden suite); rooms are sold together with a dinner reservation.
